Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing projects recommended by the public works board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorization for projects recommended by thepublic works board; creating a new section; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:
